verdict.rationale: Ironclad has a documented API for launching workflows, creating/retrieving records, and managing signature workflows, which could technically support an agent-driven NDA drafting and routing flow, but there is no evidence of an MCP server, no evidence of AI-agent-specific drafting capability via API, and no end-to-end example combining drafting + routing for signature via API in one flow. missing for 10: MCP server or endpoint, evidence of AI-driven contract drafting through the API (vs. no-code builder UI), a documented end-to-end example combining draft+route+sign via API, and independent/hands-on confirmation of agentic use.
